subject: Re: MAP & evaluation -> dedicated reservation terms for 8-GPU pool
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@edgecloud.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Interest in dedicated capacity + MAP for inference evaluation

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking the time at AI Infra Summit last week — EdgeCloud.ai has a handful of latency-sensitive ML features we want to move into production. Were interested in Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput. High-level ask: a 60-day evaluation culminating in a decision to reserve capacity (target: 12-mo term) if MAP milestones are met.

Target workload: 8-GPU pool (A100/80GB equiv), average steady-state inference 1.2M tokens/day, burst headroom to 24 GPUs during peak. Key eval criteria: p99 latency under 120ms for 2K token context, KV cache efficiency, and cost / token estimates for steady state vs burst.

Can you send a proposed MAP/eval plan and ballpark pricing for:
- 8-GPU reserved pool (monthly commit)
- burst to 24 GPUs (billing model for burst)
- 12-month term discount vs month-to-month

Wed like to start evaluation in early July and aim to finalize commercial terms by mid-August. Who from your side should I coordinate with?

Best,
Elena
Head of Platform, EdgeCloud.ai

Attachments: None

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena@edgecloud.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in dedicated capacity + MAP for inference evaluation

Elena,

Great to connect — appreciate the detail. I put together a one-page MAP and an initial pricing sketch (attached). High level proposal:

MAP / Eval plan (timeline):
- Week 0 (kickoff): onboarding, access to private eval cluster, baseline runs (we'll provision 8 GPUs)
- Weeks 1-3: performance testing (latency, KV hit-rate), integration with prefix caching and batching
- Week 4: internal demo + acceptance checklist sign-off (pooled metrics)
- Weeks 5-8: pilot with scaled traffic (observability + telemetry)
- Week 9-10: pricing review and decision point; target commercial signature by Aug 15

Commercial sketch (ballpark):
- Base reserved 8-GPU pool: $2.10 / GPU-hour (list) with a 12-month commit discount schedule below
- Burst to 24 GPUs: billed at on-demand uplift of +65% over reserved rate; automated burst where available with capacity guardrails
- Ramp / commit: option to start with a 3-month ramp (pay as you go) and convert to reserved with retroactive credit for committed months

Next steps: please review attached Proposed_MAP_v1.pdf. Would you be available for a 30-min call Friday to walk through acceptance criteria and burst notification window?

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Proposed_MAP_v1.pdf (stub)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in dedicated capacity + MAP for inference evaluation

Vanessa — added a few commercial guardrails and a recommended pricing cadence for the 8-GPU scenario. See notes below; I'll attach a spreadsheet with modeled TCO.

Suggested changes (commercial ops):
- Discount tiers (12-mo term): 0-3 months (pilot) = 0% discount, months 4-6 = 10% off list, months 7-12 = 18% off list. Encourages earlier conversion.
- Burst billing: two options to offer to customer:
  1) Automated burst: billed at +65% on top of reserved hourly rate; no notice required but capped at 48 GPU-hours per week unless pre-agreed.
  2) Scheduled burst (preferred): customer schedules burst windows with 48h notice; billed at +45% and guaranteed capacity subject to pool availability.
- Ramp credits: if they convert to reserve within first 90 days, apply retroactive credit for GPU-hours above 70% of committed baseline.
- SLA / exceptions: can agree to a 99.9% availability SLA for the reserved pool; any exceptions require approval from Platform Ops and may affect pricing.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/contacts/EDGE-1034 | Draft DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/1234ABCD

Ill attach Redwood_Dedicated_Pricing_v2.xlsx with modeled scenarios for 8/16/24 pools.

-Neha
Director, Commercial Ops

Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_Pricing_v2.xlsx (stub)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena@edgecloud.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in dedicated capacity + MAP for inference evaluation

Hi Elena — forwarding an updated commercial approach from our Commercial Ops lead (Neha) and a pricing workbook that models the ramp/discounts. Key changes to note: scheduled burst (48h notice) yields a lower uplift (+45%) and we can offer a retroactive ramp credit if you convert in the first 90 days.

Per your ask, we can target the timeline below: start onboarding wk of Jul 6, evaluation run Jul 13-31, pilot Aug 1-14, sign by Aug 15. If you can confirm well slot onboarding.

Quoted below for context:
> Neha: "Discount tiers (12-mo term): 0-3 months = 0% discount; months 4-6 = 10%; months 7-12 = 18%. Scheduled burst (48h notice) = +45% uplift; automated burst = +65% uplift capped. Ramp credit applies if convert within 90 days."

If procurement has specific contractual asks (SLA exceptions, KMS/HSM requirements, SOC2 evidence), loop them in and well coordinate with Security/Compliance.

Thanks,
Vanessa

Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_Pricing_v2.xlsx (stub), Proposed_MAP_v1.pdf (stub)

Subject: Re: Interest in dedicated capacity + MAP for inference evaluation

Hi Vanessa / Neha,

Thanks — a few procurement questions before we proceed to signature:
1) Can you confirm SOC 2 Type II status and provide the latest audit report? Also need evidence of encryption-at-rest (KMS/HSM) options.
2) Burst clause: we prefer scheduled bursts with 72h notice, not 48h. Is that flexible?
3) Termination & credits: please provide the exact credit language if Redwood fails to meet MAP acceptance criteria.
4) Can you send a DocuSign with coverage for the 12-month SOW + reserved pool addendum?

Attached is our signed NDA for your records: EdgeCloud_NDA_signed.pdf

Procurement will be available for a brief call Wed to hash legal points.

Regards,
Procurement Team
EdgeCloud.ai

Attachments: EdgeCloud_NDA_signed.pdf (stub)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in dedicated capacity + MAP for inference evaluation

Vanessa/Neha — answered procurement questions and proposed final redlines below. Ive copied the legal/ops templates well use.

Responses / redlines:
- SOC2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II compliant; we can provide the report under NDA (attach when legal confirms).
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys (KMIP/KMS integrations) for Private deployments; for Dedicated we can provide KMS-backed encryption with customer KMS integration on request.
- Burst window: flexible to 72h scheduled notice. Well keep automated burst as an opt-in with capped hours and higher uplift.
- MAP acceptance & credits: propose acceptance checklist with metric thresholds (p99 latency, KV hit rate). If Redwood misses acceptance obligations, apply pro-rated credits equal to 50% of the cost of affected GPU-hours for the acceptance week (legal to confirm precise wording).
- DocuSign: ready to seed SOW + reserved pool addendum (will use DEAL-2026-EDGE-1034 template).

Timeline recommendation: onboard July 13, acceptance sign-off by July 31, pilot Aug 1-14, contract executed Aug 15. We can tighten to Aug 1 if EdgeCloud is ready to accelerate.

-Marcus
Head of Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments: None (templates referenced)
